# BioAtlas

> Open field atlas that joins molecular phylogeny and taxonomy for the plants, animals and fungi travellers actually see. Structured data in JSON, a static JSON API, a zero-dependency web UI and full docs. Model-neutral: any AI or person may read, modify and extend it.

Status: every record is `review_status: "seed"` (drafted, not yet verified against primary literature). Do not present seed claims as established fact.

## Read the data directly (no build needed)

- [Species records](https://github.com/travelagentshawn/BioAtlas/tree/main/data/species): one JSON file per species (id = file name)
- [Taxa records](https://github.com/travelagentshawn/BioAtlas/tree/main/data/taxa): tree nodes with `parent`, `phylo.monophyly`, `phylo.age_mya` (ranges)
- [Region records](https://github.com/travelagentshawn/BioAtlas/tree/main/data/regions): destinations and scenes with species by month
- [Source records](https://github.com/travelagentshawn/BioAtlas/tree/main/data/sources): citations and taxonomy authority register\n- [Taxonomy governance](https://github.com/travelagentshawn/BioAtlas/blob/main/docs/en/taxonomy-authorities.md): layered authorities, name assertions, versioning and conflict policy
- [JSON Schemas](https://github.com/travelagentshawn/BioAtlas/tree/main/schema): the format of every record

## Read the compiled API (after `npm run build`, served under /api/v1/)

- manifest.json: entry point listing every endpoint and counts
- tree.json: whole phylogeny, nested
- species.json, species/{id}.json: species list and full records (lineage, regions, closest relatives, sources)
- taxa.json, taxa/{id}.json; regions.json, regions/{id}.json; calendar.json; sources.json; taxonomic-authorities.json; search.json\n- Full species and taxon records may include `taxonomic_assertions[]`; conflicting provider claims are preserved, and unverified IDs must remain `unassessed`.
- Contract: [contract/api-v1.schema.json](https://github.com/travelagentshawn/BioAtlas/blob/main/contract/api-v1.schema.json) and [contract/endpoints.json](https://github.com/travelagentshawn/BioAtlas/blob/main/contract/endpoints.json)

## How to contribute

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/travelagentshawn/BioAtlas/blob/main/AGENTS.md): rules, roles, commands for any AI agent
- [Documentation (English)](https://github.com/travelagentshawn/BioAtlas/tree/main/docs/en) / [中文](https://github.com/travelagentshawn/BioAtlas/tree/main/docs/zh) / [日本語](https://github.com/travelagentshawn/BioAtlas/tree/main/docs/ja)
- Commands: `npm run validate`, `npm run build`, `npm run check` (Node >= 20, no dependencies)

## Optional

- Trip interchange format: [schema/trip.schema.json](https://github.com/travelagentshawn/BioAtlas/blob/main/schema/trip.schema.json)
- Licences: code MIT, data CC BY 4.0
